content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad has advertised staff recruitment for a research project titled "Understanding the correlates of vaccine-induced immune response: an Indian cohort study involving HPV vaccines". The post is advertised for the project at ESIC MC&H, Faridabad, and is open to eligible Indian nationals. The appointment is purely temporary/contractual and carries no claim to regular employment.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 30 years. The notice marks the age limit with an asterisk; the application form has a field "Age As on 01.12.2026". The notice prints no age relaxation. Only eligible Indian nationals may apply. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: 12th Pass with one year experience in medical research projects/ community surveys
rows.desirable: Work experience as Sanitary inspector/ health educator/MPHW

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Field Worker post carries a consolidated salary of Rs. 23,400/-. The appointment is initially for 11 months and is extendable subject to satisfactory performance, continuation of the project, availability of funds and approval of the competent authority. The project duration is 2 years. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview or joining the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC MC&H Faridabad Field Worker
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application Form printed in the notice (titled "Staff Recruitment (Contractual) for Research Project") and affix a recent passport-size photograph. Write the post applied for in the form and complete the sections on personal details, correspondence and permanent address, contact details, educational qualification and professional experience. Sign and date the declaration at the end of the form. Attach the documents listed below. Email the application to [email protected] so that it reaches before 04:00 PM on 1 December 2026. The notice does not specify a subject line for the email. Completed Application Form with passport-size photograph Self-attested educational qualification certificates of 10th and 12th Experience certificates Identity proof (Aadhar card/Pan card/Voter ID/Driving license) Proof of Date of Birth (listed in the application form)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on screening of applications, a written test (if required) and an interview by the Selection Panel. Only shortlisted candidates will be considered for interview. The date of the interview/skill test is to be notified. Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee selection.
